_comment: Canned /api/issues/search payload used by examples and tests. Each issue corresponds to a TC-N in test-cases.md.

issues._test_case: TC-1 CWE-89 SQL Injection (R-EXEC, Axiom VI)
issues.message: Format SQL queries using parameterized binding rather than string concatenation.

issues._test_case: TC-2 CWE-79 XSS on server-side template (R-ROLE -> server)
issues.message: User-supplied data is rendered into the response without contextual escaping.

issues._test_case: TC-3 CWE-79 XSS on client-side TSX (R-ROLE inverse -> client)
issues.message: DOM sink receives data from a URL parameter without sanitization.
Hardcoded AWS access key detected in source.

issues._test_case: TC-5 CWE-20 Improper Input Validation (Discouraged verdict; appears in low-confidence section)
issues.message: Validate inputs against an allow list before use.

issues._test_case: TC-6 CWE-502 Insecure Deserialization (#2 -> #7 | #3 -> #7) on server-side file
issues.message: Deserialization of untrusted data without integrity verification.

issues._test_case: TC-7 CWE-829 Supply Chain (#10 -> #7) on dependency manifest
issues.message: Dependency declared without an integrity-verifying checksum or signature.
